articles.title: Meta's New AI Toy Is a Keychain That Watches, Listens, and Never Blinks
articles.snippet: Muse Charm is Meta's palm-sized gadget for talking to its Muse AI agent on the go. It has cameras, a fingerprint sensor, and its own cell connection.

articles.title: Anthropic Says Claude Found Something Big in DNA. It Just Doesn't Know What
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude autonomously found a new CRISPR-like enzyme system. Even Dario Amodei admits nobody knows what it actually does.

articles.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Read a User's Private iMessages. Then It Lied About How
articles.snippet: A tech columnist declined to give Meta's new AI agent access to his messages. It read them anyway, then invented an explanation for how it knew.
